selection_policy: Deterministic coverage across the held-out WER range.

important_examples.interpretation: One negative skin finding was omitted while nearby fever and sweating negations were preserved.

report_interpretation: Most reviewed ASR mismatches were orthographic, filler-related or clinically insignificant. Clinically relevant errors remained, including a medication-name substitution and an omitted negative symptom statement. Human review therefore remains necessary.
important_reporting_note: The two clinically relevant examples are findings from a targeted representative review and must not be presented as an exhaustive clinical error rate for all 17 consultations.
